answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 2932 Country: United Arab Emirates Title: My age is 28 years. Most of my beard and hairs on my head have become grey in colour and i am not yet married. Can i use black colour dye. i tried using heena but it is very much visible that the hairs are grey. so please advice on my email. Question: My age is 28 years. Most of my beard and hairs on my head have become grey in colour and i am not yet married. Can i use black colour dye. i tried using heena but it is very much visible that the hairs are grey. so please advice on my email. Answer ID: 2932 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 138/138=L) In the above-mentioned case, it is not allowed to dye with black colour, the other colours can be used: والحق ان احادیث المنع عن السواد واضحۃ مطلقۃ و لیس فیھا ما یخصھا بارادۃ الغش والخداع ولذا اختار عامۃ المشائخ المنع ۔۔۔ ومثلہ فی رد المحتار، وھو الذی اختارہ والدی رحمہ اللہ فی جواھر الفقہ 2/430 عملاً بالاحتیاط ( تکملہ فتح الملھم: 4/150 ) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
